_doc: Single source of truth for which Claude model each job runs on. Callers name a ROLE; only this file names a model id. Changing a role's model changes product output: do it on Zach's go, after scripts/model_drift_check.py flags a newer model and an eval compares old vs new. Gate: scripts/model_id_gate.py (pre-commit) blocks hardcoded ids elsewhere.
